items.title: C1 compact functions lie in the same closed gradient graph

source.anchor: PBPS arXiv:2609.06905v1 Appendix C.1 proof of Lemma B.1/Lemma C.1 compact-smooth-to-weighted-H1 analytic prerequisite; Section2.2 equations2.6-2.14 actual reflected conditional law. SPHMC2609.06906v1 Section4.1 BL actual-resolvent dependency only.
source.attribution: Samplinglib explicit full-space analytic prerequisite to Chen, Chewi, Lu and Zhang Appendix C.1; not a quoted numbered theorem or full Lemma C.1/Poincare result.

items.statement: For every finite Borel measure mu, every closable partial gradient D whose original graph is exactly compact smooth scalar representatives and their genuine gradients, and every C1 compact scalar f, derive MemLp f 2 mu and MemLp (gradient f) 2 mu and prove the actual pair of their L2 classes lies in D.closure.graph. No graph-membership or approximation certificate is supplied.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable structure and canonical volume, including dimension zero. mu is any finite measure; no absolute-continuity or Gibbs hypothesis on mu is required.

D is the same closable real-linear partial operator, with original graph iff actual C-infinity compact scalar representatives and their genuine gradients, both classes identified mu-a.e. This semantics comes from the existing gradient producer in the paper consumer.
The tested scalar f is only C1 and compactly supported. Its gradient, L2 integrability and actual closure membership are conclusions, not inputs.
